notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hey ! ːsteamhappyː
Another day - another RC Revolution: High Voltage Update!

 Today's Patch Notesːsteamhappyː


 Pause no longer activates over the results screen.
 Added controller support to the pause menu.
 Added hints for both controller and keyboard.
 Fixed saving of tournament points and current track - achievement fix.
 FPS fix (now the choice is either 30 or 60, default is 30)
 Fixed the Pause window (gamepad control, hints for gamepad and keyboard).
 Fixed a critical bug with Tournaments (if you exit the game mid-tournament, the tournament would crash; starting a New Game was the only solution).

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
RC Revolution: High Voltage Prologue - Patch Notesːsteamhappyː


 Fixed UI in Lobby Home.
 Added Stunt Mode.
 Added Booster Mode.
 AI Challenge moved to the last spot in the tournament sequence (logical since full car upgrades are possible only after completing everything).
 Added "Back" buttons in Boosters and Select Track.
 Fixed Cobra upgrade issues.
 Fixed "Blue Screen" error.
 Fixed a non-functioning achievement for 3 wins (testing needed!).
 Rocket Booster significantly sped up and explosion power increased.
 Mine Booster explosion power increased.
 Fixed BigTrack course, corrected barriers at the last turn.
 Fixed Seafront Boosters track, added barrier at the start.
 Sound fix
 Corrected a typo in "Standard" in settings.
 Added an exit button from the pre-race window.
 Fixed incorrect avatar display in tournament table.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Greetings RC fam,

We are excited to announce the release of the Day One Patch. Here are the details of the updates:

  
 Tutorial Adjustment: The ball in the tutorial has been removed to enhance player experience and avoid unnecessary distractions.

   Cobra Car Performance: Adjustments have been made to the Cobra car's parameters to improve its overall performance.

   Help Window Addition: A help window for ATV and Cobra has been added in the 'Select Car' section for better guidance.

   Respawn System Improvement: The respawn system has been enhanced, allowing players to respawn on the test track for a more seamless experience.

   Introduction of Advanced Series: A new Advanced Series has been added, offering more challenging races for our competitive players.

   Navigation Enhancement: We've implemented an easier navigation system, including quick 'Esc' key functionality in PreLobby and an easy exit to the menu from the race start.

   Track Safety Improvements: Additional fences have been added on off-road parts of available tracks to enhance player safety and experience.

   Extended AI Challenge: The AI challenge now features a 15-lap race, providing a more robust and challenging competition.

   Music Issue Acknowledgement: We are aware of the existing music issue and are actively working on a fix, which will be included in our next patch update.


Thank you for your continuous support and feedback, which are invaluable in our ongoing efforts to improve RC Revolution High Voltage.
